included_organizations: Ololedwa ndi mabungwe onse andale: mwachitsanzo masukulu, mayunivesite, masukulu ophunzitsa ndi asayansi, mabungwe a makolo ndi ophunzira, makampani, ma NGO, magulu azipembedzo
united_earth_is_1: Pali anthu ambiri omwe akufuna kupulumutsa dziko lathu lapansi. Mabungwe osawerengeka, mabungwe, makampani ndi anthu osakwatira. Koma sitikudziwa kwa wina ndi mnzake.
united_earth_is_3: Tiyenera kulumikizana wina ndi mnzake kuti tiwonetse momwe kuyenda kwathu kuliri kwamphamvu. Ngati tikudziwa kuti ndife angati, titha kuthandiza anthu kusintha malingaliro awo pakusintha kwanyengo kukhala olimba mtima komanso olimba mtima. Titha kupatsa anthu mphamvu kuti ayambe njira zawo zodzitetezera nyengo. Pamodzi pokha titha kusintha dziko ndikupulumutsa nyengo!
united_earth_is_4: Sinthani dziko lolembetsa patsamba lathu! Ndife ambiri!
united_earth_is_5: Tikukupemphani kuti mugawane izi ndi abwenzi, abwenzi komanso anzanu.
united_earth_is_7: Ophunzira 200 ndi aphunzitsi 30 pasukulu ya ku Austria
united_earth_is_8: Pulojekiti yopita ku ecolabel ya ku Austria
about_us_2: Ngati tiwonetsa kuchuluka kwathu, titha kuthandiza anthu kuti asinthe momwe akumvera pakusintha kwanyengo kuchoka pakusowa chiyembekezo kukhala olimba mtima komanso achidaliro. Titha kupatsa anthu mphamvu kuti ayambe njira zawo zodzitetezera nyengo.
about_us_3: Koma koposa zonse: Sitingadzimve kukhala tokha komanso opanda mphamvu. Zingatibweretsere limodzi. Zitipatsa chiyembekezo, mphamvu, kulimba mtima komanso chidaliro. Titha kumva kulumikizidwa padziko lonse lapansi - kupulumutsa pulaneti lathu ndikugwira ntchito yodzakhala ndi tsogolo labwino.
about_us_4: Cholinga chathu ndikupatsa anthu kulimba mtima, chidaliro komanso mphamvu zoyambitsa njira zawo zodzitetezera nyengo.
about_us_5: Chenjezo: Palibe kumenya nkhondo chifukwa cha malingaliro osiyanasiyana - kutsimikiza, osati kukakamizidwa kuyenera kukhala maziko oti titeteze dziko lathu lapansi.
about_us_6: Anthu 100, onse olankhula zilankhulo zosiyanasiyana, amapalasa bwato limodzi kulowera ku mathithi. Pafupifupi aliyense m'bwatomo amadziwa zoopsa. Koma pafupifupi aliyense amaganiza kuti ndi yekhayo amene akudziwa za izi. "Ndingatani?", Aliyense amaganiza. "Kupalasa kwinaku kulibe ntchito!" Ndipo aliyense amachita zamakhalidwe akale. Chingachitike ndi chiyani ngati mwadzidzidzi aliyense atadziwa za mnzake - akudziwa kuti aliyense akufuna kubwerera ndikumatha kulankhulana?
about_us_8: United-Earth2025 - gawo laling'ono lopezeka pa ecolabel waku Austria.
about_us_9: Webusaitiyi ndi masamba olumikizidwa ndi atolankhani amapangidwa ndi ophunzira 200 ndi aphunzitsi pasukulu ya ku Austria.
about_us_10: Ntchitoyi idachitika ngati gawo laling'ono lopezeka pamsonkhano wa ku Austria. Zinthu zonse za webusaitiyi zidapangidwa ngati ntchito yasukulu.
about_us_11: Titha kutsatira zipembedzo zosiyanasiyana, osiyana zaka komanso komwe adachokera, koma tonsefe tikufuna kupulumutsa dziko lathu lapansi. Ophunzira onse ndi odzipereka.
